Analysis Visit
Derivation: Derived based on windowing algorithm described in SAP, Section 8.2

Label: Analysis Relative Day
Derivation: ADY = ADT - TRTSDT + 1, if ADT>=TRTSDT. ADY = ADT - TRTSDT, if ADT<TRTSDT.

Label: Parameter (N)
Derivation: Assign a numeric code for each value of PARAMCD (see codelistPARAMN_ADQSADAS)

Label: Analysis Value
Derivation: ACITM01, ACITM02, ACITM03, ACITM04, ACITM05, ACITM06, ACITM07, ACITM08, ACITM09, ACITM10, ACITM11, ACITM12, ACITM13, ACITM14: QS.QSSTRESN where QSTESTCD=PARAMCD | ACTOT: Sum of ADAS scores for items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, and 14, see SAP section 14.2 for details on adjusting for missing values.

Label: Analysis Record Flag 01
Derivation: If multiple visits fall into the same visit window, then the one closest to the target date is chosen for analysis. These are flagged with ANL01FL="Y".

Label: Derivation Type
Derivation: ACITM01, ACITM02, ACITM03, ACITM04, ACITM05, ACITM06, ACITM07, ACITM08, ACITM09, ACITM10, ACITM11, ACITM12, ACITM13, ACITM14: Value: null | ACTOT: Value: LOCF denotes that the LOCF imputation method was used to impute the value for the given parameter and analysis visit.

Label: Analysis Window Valid Relative Range
Derivation: Window range, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Target
Derivation: Target day within the window, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Diff from Target
Derivation: Absolute difference between AWTARGET and ADY

Label: Analysis Window Beginning Timepoint
Derivation: Start day of the window, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Ending Timepoint
Derivation: End day of the window, specified in the SAP.

Label: Sequence Number
Derivation: ACITM01, ACITM02, ACITM03, ACITM04, ACITM05, ACITM06, ACITM07, ACITM08, ACITM09, ACITM10, ACITM11, ACITM12, ACITM13, ACITM14: QS.QSSEQ | ACTOT: Set QSSEQ to missing for post baseline records. Set to QS.QSSEQ where QS.VISIT=BASELINE and QS.QSTESTCD=ACTOT.
